helpers.stack_frame_description: SUB sp,sp,#640 at5893 gives a fixed640-byte frame; there is no ADDVL/RDVL scalable allocation. STP/LDP d8,d9 atsp+112, d10,d11 at+128, d12,d13 at+144 and d14,d15 at+160 preserve ABI low64-bit values. The remaining stack accesses are X/W register saves, scalar dimensions, input/kernel/output pointer locals and outgoing scalar call arguments.
helpers.spill_count_scope: Static Z/Q/predicate data-spill instruction sites in the complete actual helper including all setup, transitions, skipped-loop initialization, output stores and both fallback paths. ABI D-register saves/restores are excluded; these numbers are not dynamic memory-operation counts.
helpers.spill_notes: No Z/Q LDR/STR, no predicate spill and no vector LD/ST through a stack-derived address were found in5890..6997. The only constructed SP alias is x29=sp+16, which never becomes a vector-memory base. Integer LDR/LDP reload external pointers from fixed slots: input-row bases atsp+184..312 and+464..600, kernel bases at+432..456/+512/+608..624, and output pointers at+392..424. Their provenance is input/kernel/dst arguments plus row/column offsets, not the stack locations themselves. All45 LD1W and25 LD1RW static sites in the nine loops use those external pointers; the25 ST1W sites at6684..6740 target the five output rows. Four vector MOV instructions in shared are register-to-register relocations, not spills.
helpers.transition_spill_review: Read the entire helper5890..6997, not only its arithmetic loops. Entry5970..6125 constructs external input/kernel pointers and integer locals; leading stage exits6167..6183,6218..6231 and6278..6290 initialize the next output row without vector stack traffic. .L408 at6349 initializes e and sets t=4; .L418 at6371 enters shared. Kernel pointers x4/x5/x6/x7/x11 initially represent rows4/3/2/1/0, advance by x13=4*kw at6478..6482, and input row pointers advance by x14=4*stride at6483..6486. t increments once at6477 and .L418 repeats until kh. At shared entry/exit the25 acc remain in registers; n0 temporarily relocates b0 fromz14 toz12, restores it, then n1 similarly relocates b1 fromz13 toz12 and restores it. The trailing stages6490..6673 read their final kernel rows in order with no spill/reload between phases. .L419 at6674 emits25 full-vector output stores before horizontal pointers advance. .L429 at6843 supplies zero-valued accumulators when kw<=0 and rejoins .L408; it does not materialize stack-resident vectors. No live output accumulator crosses a fallback call.
helpers.tail_and_fallback_review: Entry CMP w3,4 / BLE .L405 implements kh<5 before leading-row pointer construction or arithmetic. .L4056947..6979 calls rowquad for outputs0..3 with original width, then tail-branches prefix for output4 at base+4*stride. Full horizontal tiles are gated by CNTW mul#5 and ow-i>=5*lanes; INCW mul#5 at6725 advances exactly that tile width. .L4496980..6994 initializes i=0 for ow<5*lanes, then .L407 compares ow with i. .L4506886..6946 handles any remaining0<ow-i<5*lanes by rowquad at column i for the first four rows and prefix at input row4, column i for the fifth row; dst pointers retain their external row spacing. It restores the frame before the prefix tail branch. The vector-using path restores d8..d15 before entering .L407; width-small and kh<5 paths branch before those saves and do not restore unsaved D registers. Every phase is a single-column loop starting ik=0 and incrementing by1, with CMP/BGT against kw; odd/even kw and kw=1 use the same loop, with no paired/quartet remainder or wide coefficient read. The final loaded horizontal vector starts at i+4*lanes+ik and ends at i+5*lanes+ik-1; the full-tile condition and ik<kw bound it by ow+kw-2. The last input row is kh+3, needed by output row4. Per-output kernel rows and columns remain increasing, with separate FMUL then FADD.

helpers.nonshared_remainder_review: All nine actual phases advance one kernel column per iteration; there is no nonshared or shared unrolled-column remainder. Horizontal remaining columns are handled by rowquad plus prefix as described above.
helpers.whole_helper_count_scope: Static instruction sites from function label through .size. Shared repeats for each middle input row and every phase repeats for kw, so125 FMUL/125 FADD/45 input loads/25 broadcasts here are not per-call dynamic totals. Whole-helper ST1W count is25. Internal input-pointer bookkeeping and ABI traffic are included in total instructions.
helpers.shared_instruction_interpretation: 73 instructions per single-column iteration include25 ordinary vector FMUL,25 FADD,5 input LD1W,5 coefficient LD1RW,4 vector MOV,1 LSL,6 ADD,1 CMP and1 BGT. No indexed FMUL, LD1RQW, DUP, EXT, MOVPRFX or vector stack access occurs there. The explicit asm has no hardware barrier instruction; Bohr separately reviews concrete operands and compiler constraints. This machine evidence alone does not establish throughput or a speedup.

performance_claim: None. This is an actual assembly review for diagnostic acceptance only; compiler acceptance and zero spills do not imply a faster implementation.
